title: Final-mile launch huddle notes (scratchpad)
content:
Context: weekly prep for Launch Train 3 -> production rollout next Wed (2026-03-04). Personal scratchpad for the huddle: capture quick blockers, go/no-go flags, owners to ping, and follow-ups. Not polished — for my eyes and quick share in the meeting.

Attendees I want present: SRE (Mel), Serving Runtime eng lead (Omar), QA (Jules), Product Ops (Dani), Docs/DevRel (Sam), CS lead (Riley), Release Manager (Ash). If any of these can't make it, ask for delegate ahead.

High-level target: public endpoint stable, 99th p95 latency <= 450ms for small-chat profile, canary at 5% traffic for 48h, rollback window 2h.

Current top-of-mind risks (quick):
- Canary autoscaler flaps under burst (observed on last canary at 3% traffic spike). Likely KEDA config edge; Mel + infra to validate scaling thresholds.
- Token billing/attribution mismatch for embed calls -> finance noticed spike in sandbox. Possible meter mapping bug: INF-6132.
- On-prem package install script errors on RHEL 8 (customer pilot). DevRel has patch but not yet validated on RHEL8.
- Missing SLO doc for dedicated customers using HSM (legal asked). Need concise blurb for sales pack.

Go/no-go checklist (quick binary flags I want to run through):
- [ ] Infra: Canary environment stable for 24h (no OOMs, no restarts > 3) — owner: Mel (SRE)
- [ ] Serving runtime: KV cache warmup deterministic for common prompts (scripts green) — owner: Omar
- [ ] QA: regression tests (LLM-quality) run against seed prompt set; no >10% BLEU/embedding drift on key intents — owner: Jules
- [ ] Telemetry: Data plane traces + per-route token cost visible in dashboard — owner: Dani (Product Ops)
- [ ] Billing: sample invoices for enterprise pilot validated — owner: Laura (Finance) — blocked by INF-6132
- [ ] Docs/DevRel: quickstart + migration note published to /docs/quickstart-launch — owner: Sam
- [ ] CS: customer playbook + postmortem template prepared — owner: Riley
- [ ] Security: KMS integration smoke test + audit log verification — owner: Maya (Sec)
- [ ] Legal: compliance checklist accepted for EU launch variant — owner: Ben (Legal)

Notes/probes for each owner before the huddle:
- Mel: can you share last 24h of canary pod restarts and autoscaler events (link)
- Omar: attach one-liner on KV-cache warmup script and expected cold start penalty in tokens/ms
- Jules: quick list of failing test ids (if any) and severity mapping -> ship/no-ship
- Dani: confirm dashboard retention for 90 days in staging and prod is set, and that sampling is enabled for traces
- Riley: confirm CS-runbook includes contact rotation for nights/weekends during soft-launch

Immediate action items (my personal TODOs going into the meeting):
- Ping Mel + Omar in #release-3-huddle at T-72h to confirm canary window start time (PRIORITY)
- Prepare one-slide summary for execs: top 3 risks, mitigation, ask (need 2 mins max)
- Draft comms blurb for customers (short) and internal all-hands (longer) — get Sam to review

Rollback criteria (draft — discuss & lock in):
- Automatic rollback if: sustained 5xx rate > 1% for 30m AND p95 latency > 700ms for 15m
- Manual rollback: any loss of routing/ingress for >5m or data integrity incidents
- Ops: rollback playbook must be staged and smoke-tested in staging today (owner: Ash)

Canary plan sketch:
- Start: 02-Mar 02:00 UTC 5% traffic, ramp to 15% over 4h if green (no SLI breaches)
- Monitor: token cost, p95 latency (chat small/large), 5xx, memory footprint, KV hit rate, autoscaler events
- Alerts: Slack + PagerDuty for thresholds (Mel to confirm thresholds)
- Post-canary: hold + retrospective before full rollout

Communication / comms readiness:
- External: short blurb for release notes, include migration tips (Sam) -> draft by EOD today
- Internal: #release-3-huddle pinned checklist with owners + escalation matrix (I'll update)
- Customer emails: targeted pilot customers only for first 48h; Riley to approve list

Open questions / discussion points we should cover quickly:
- Do we need to delay the on-prem packaging for GA? If yes, shift messaging to \"hosted first, on-prem pilot\". (DevRel preference?)
- Is the 48h canary long enough given weekend team coverage? Would prefer 72h if no SRE on-call gap.
- Billing mapping bug INF-6132: what is mitigation if invoices already generated? (Finance input)

Parking lot (non-blocking but worth tracking):
- Post-launch: cost-optimization runbook (Optimize team)
- Runbook to auto-scale embeddings-heavy routes differently than chat routes
- Follow-up: evals regression dashboard to be hooked into alerts (Research/Applied ML)

Meeting flow I plan to follow (7–12 min total):
1) Quick roll call + owners present (1m)
2) Exec 2-min summary (my slide) (2m)
3) Rapid go/no-go checklist walk (5m) — call out any fails and immediate mitigation
4) Confirm canary start timestamp + on-call handoff (2m)
5) AOB / parking lot + confirm follow-ups (2m)

Post-meeting follow-ups (record in ticket INF-RT3-LAUNCH):
- Ash to file rollback confirmation + smoke-test evidence (due: T-48h)
- Mel/Omar: autoscaler tuning PR (link) and staging run evidence (due: T-48h)
- Jules: attach failing tests + triage notes (due: T-24h)
- Sam: publish quickstart and signal when live (due: T-24h)
- Riley: finalize pilot customer list and notify CS reps (due: T-24h)

Quick links I will paste in meeting chat:
- JIRA: INF-6132, INF-6790, INF-6841
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/4123
- Staging dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/staging/release-3-canary (internal)
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Release+Train+3+Runbook

Notes to self: keep it brief in the meeting, call out only blocking risks, and move discussions to follow-up threads. Capture owners live in the meeting and update ticket INF-RT3-LAUNCH.

—— end scratchpad ——
